DAG.conditional_basis: Old complete P/N bits and canonical directory/next metadata are untrusted proposals, not a Lean premise
DAG.stop_reason: Two million candidate edge work limit; the current layer is not fully expanded
findings: P nodes retain all indexed SAFE successors; N nodes choose one proposed P successor
Per-level greedy set cover shares an existential N response between several N parents
Compared at layer8, greedy cover uses2538 P targets versus9562 prospective first-witness P targets
Despite sharing, the observed chosen prefix grows about ninefold per two early layers
This does not establish that every strategy DAG must have that growth
The historical mid22 closed DAG has1043 nodes/2154 edges versus47475 tree nodes and only39 numeric local patterns

compression.selection_bias: Largest bucket in each layer20..27, start/middle/tail; not a random or representative full-table sample
compression.interpretation: High dictionary repetition despite bit runs mostly3.5..9.6bits; most middle/tail full directory blocks are not monochrome or exactly duplicated

LZ77.copy_semantics: For a pre-copy prefix of length n, output byte j is prefix[n-distance+(j mod distance)]
LZ77.caveat: Even this density is20884 tokens per MiB. Storage compression alone is not a20hour proof or fresh-replay bound

flat_planes.important_binding: Use each side.view_in_saved_span with its raw_span word; top-level views use absolute bucket row offsets
flat_planes.scope: Only actual numeric next i-to-j planes with distinct groups; not complete SAFE successors or a whole block proof
flat_planes.source_only_extension: Changing the unique group in AAB/ABB also gives compatible FlatViews when the free pair is flattened by colex rank

proof_obligations: Every supplied label remains an untrusted proposal until an ordinary Lean proof checks its recurrence or equivalent strategy certificate
Canonical sharing needs actual symmetry witnesses and complete physical P coverage; equal summaries or equal group numbers are not a game-equivalence theorem
Closed finite DAGs can inherit source SAFE from actually checked leaves by the proved downward-closure theorem
Unsafe children can be excluded using concrete legal next moves and valid winning14tile subsets, avoiding repeated rule search
A byte grammar must be linked to actual Boolean/kernel recurrence checking; byte roundtrip does not establish any game outcome
Any20hour claim must include proof generation, all finite premises, actual data binding, standard-library cold replay, and final original-game theorem
